thread:
sara-support: FYI customer (tenant: acme-analytics) reports their SIEM is showing periodic empty batches from our forwarder since yesterday; they say ~30m of audit events are missing. any ideas?

mike-engsec: which sink? Splunk HEC or a customer syslog endpoint?

sara-support: Splunk HEC (us-east), index=acme_events. forwarded via forwarder-v2. customer says manifests show objects but when they download the gz the payloads are empty.

anita-support: customer attached manifest + object key: s3://redwood-audit/exports/tenant_acme/2026-03-16T22:10Z/part-0001.gz — when they gunzip it locally it's basically empty/newlines.

thomas-sre: deploy-bot shows forwarder-v2 replica-3 had restarts in the window 22:08-22:40; logs show some backpressure and occasional 413s from HEC.

deploy-bot: forwarder-v2/replica-3 restarted at 2026-03-16T22:39:12Z (OOMKilled?).

mike-engsec: can someone paste the forwarder logs around 22:10? look for parse/gzip/KMS errors.

sara-support: here's the snippet the customer provided:

```
[22:09:58] forwarder: uploading part-0001.gz size=0 md5=abc1234
[22:10:01] forwarder: gzip: unexpected EOF while reading header
[22:10:01] forwarder: marking batch empty, seq=4719 tenant=acme
[22:10:05] forwarder: http_post splunk/hec -> 413 Payload Too Large
[22:10:06] forwarder: retrying batch 4719 backoff=2s
[22:11:10] forwarder: upload succeeded size=0
```

anita-support: size=0 uploads w/ md5 present is suspicious — looks like we wrote zero-length objects after a gzip failure.

kevin-privacy: any KMS/HSM errors in the encrypt path? if encryption fails we might still create a placeholder object.

mike-engsec: pulled encrypt logs for that pod:

```
kms-client: Encrypt failed: RETRYABLE: timeout contacting HSM node-2
forwarder: proceeding to upload encrypted blob with length=0?
```

thomas-sre: we saw a similar symptom last quarter where a retry path cleared the write buffer on encrypt error; the upload still went through as a 0-byte object.

vendor-splunk-bot: Splunk HEC returned 413 when payload exceeded max_content_length (configured 10MB) — observed burst from tenant with large session payloads. 413s + retries can interact poorly with forwarder batching.

sara-support: customer also flagged some manifests that reference Glacier/DeepArchive, claiming retention mishandled. they think lifecycle might have removed objects prematurely.

anita-support: checked bucket lifecycle: there's a rule for prefix 'exports/tenant_acme/2026-03-16' to transition to DeepArchive after 14d. that doesn't explain same-day deletions.

mike-engsec: putting pieces together: transient KMS timeouts -> encrypt failed -> forwarder created zero-length gz blobs (due to missing guard) -> Splunk responded 413 for oversized batches leading to retries that were erroneously marked processed -> RESULT: missing events in SIEM but manifests exist.

kevin-privacy: recommended action items:
1) Add a guard so uploads are aborted if encryption fails (do not create empty blobs).
2) Validate upload size before finalizing (size > 0).
3) Instrument an alert on repeated 413 responses combined with zero-size uploads for the same tenant.
4) Provide a replay + customer-facing timeline and compliance signoff.

mike-engsec: repro steps for engineering:
- set KMS client to simulate timeout: KMS_TIMEOUT_MS=5
- run forwarder locally with batch-interval=1s and batch-size large
- push synthetic events with long session payloads -> observe gzip errors and zero-size part uploads and 413 bursts from a local HEC stub

anita-support: I'll open a formal escalation ticket for the customer and request missing timestamp list. Customer asked for replay + SLA credit. they requested the exact window: 2026-03-16T22:08:00Z to 2026-03-16T22:40:00Z.

thomas-sre: I'll open a PR to add the encrypt-failure guard + size validation + an alert rule. assigning to eng-runtime.

sara-support: :thumbsup: thanks all — I'll coordinate replay and customer comms, and loop in @kevin-privacy for compliance signoff on the replay plan.

mike-engsec: note for follow-up: consider tuning Splunk HEC max_content_length guidance for customers with big session payloads or enable chunked uploads in forwarder to avoid 413s.

anita-support: adding remediation checklist to the ticket: replay plan, customer timeline, engineering PR link, and CSM comms. :sadpanda:

sara-support: closing loop — will update thread after replay completes and when PR is merged.
